name: level6_reliquary
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background panorama for a 2D dark-fantasy side-scrolling NES HD remake, Holy Diver Level 6. Create a new haunted green reliquary hall, a 4:3 landscape illustration designed to reduce cleanly to 512x480. All visible artwork is distant, non-collidable scenery: no foreground platforms or floor ledges. Main architecture is a long wall of weathered olive-green stone burial slabs and immense carved skull bas-reliefs, separated by narrow ribbed columns, layered with recessed stone panels and a few hanging iron chains. Distinctive broad horizontal monumental skull-wall composition, not a cathedral window hall and not a natural cave. Palette follows an original green-on-green room: dark moss and verdigris green stone, subdued jade edges, charcoal green-black recesses, slight green atmospheric haze; no bright blue windows, no red, no lava, no neon. Rich late-16-bit hand-painted pixel-art detail and crisp stone edges, restrained highlights, clear depth, sinister but beautiful, compatible with polished HD fantasy sprites. Dense architecture extends beyond all image edges, fairly even detail across the scene, readable at small scale, dark central negative spaces for player visibility. No characters, monsters, interactive objects, HUD, lettering, border, watermark, or mockup.

name: level6_green_shaft
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: non-collidable background panorama for Holy Diver Level 6, a polished dark-fantasy 2D side-scrolling NES HD remake. Create a 4:3 landscape view into a vast vertical ruined green citadel shaft, designed to reduce to 512x480. This is deep distant scenery behind small platforms: central 60 percent remains mostly dark green-black open void with faint layered architectural silhouettes and subtle atmospheric depth. On both sides and receding into the middle, very tall slender fractured stone ribs, narrow weathered vertical buttresses, distant ruined pinnacles and hanging chains emphasize a long dangerous descent. A few small distant arches with subdued yellow-green light. The native room uses bright green/jade platforms and ivory skull blocks; complement those with deep forest green and black architecture, muted verdigris stone, restrained pale moss highlights. Clearly different from a flat skull-wall corridor or blue cathedral hall: sparse, spacious, vertical, shadowed tower atmosphere. Rich late-16-bit painted pixel-art detail, crisp texture and clean readable shapes, no soft photographic blur. No natural cave rocks, no red, no blue glow, no lava, no neon, no large skull faces. No characters, creatures, foreground walkway or solid-looking foreground ledges, game HUD, text, border, watermark, or mockup. Full bleed background texture extends beyond all image edges.
